text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After we win several races, Super Creek
begins
receiving various offers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Magazine interviews, advertisements,
and even
cameos on TV. Our days are
filled to the brim just
trying to stay on
top of all the requests, until...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We can rest for a bit at last.
choice_data_list: ようやく一段落したな
ようやく一段落したね

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect opportunity to go to a
hot
spring! What do you say? We can
use the coupon
I got at that raffle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, we promised to go on a hot
spring trip
once things calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Our break starts tomorrow, so this is the
perfect
opportunity, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next day, Super Creek and I
head to
the hot spring inn.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, this place is so charming!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now I'm even more excited! ♪ Let's go.
choice_data_list: 雑誌にも載ってる有名旅館らしいぞ
雑誌にも載ってる有名旅館らしいよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We enter the inn with high expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew, that felt great! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your skin is so smooth now! And you
look really
happy too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it!
choice_data_list: ああ、仕事の疲れが吹っ飛んだ
うん、仕事の疲れが吹っ飛んだよ

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's head over to your room.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day that we're able to go
on a hot
spring trip. You need to relax
and enjoy yourself
to the fullest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Here you go! Say, "Ahh." ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't that tasty? ♪ Next up is some

wild-vegetable tempura.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is there anything else you want to eat?
Keep the
requests coming! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It looks like your shoulders are all
loosened up
now. On to your arms and
legs...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is that enough pressure? I'll massage all
the way
to your fingertips! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
After your massage comes the ear
cleaning! Come
and rest your head on
my lap! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Does that feel good?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so I receive a full-course pampering
from
Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I'm so glad we took this hot
spring trip! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I've rested plenty!
choice_data_list: ちょっとはクリークも休んだら？

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Pampering you is how I recharge! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And it's also my way of saying thank you!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You stuck by my side during the Arima
Kinen and
the whole time before that as
well, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to show you how grateful I
am! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You bet I will! ♪
choice_data_list: そういうことなら存分にやってくれ！
そういうことなら存分にやって！

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're back to our usual schedule
starting from
tomorrow, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let me spoil you like this from time to
time,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Super Creek and I have
formed an
unbreakable bond during this
time together.
